warnings: Every footing is printed 'F<n>,C2' — footing mark + the stub column C2 standing on it (C2 = 0.25 x 0.25, 4-DB12 on S-05). C2 is recorded here once (10 points); the columns above (+0.00 to +2.35 and up to the roof) are C1 on the S-01 view 2 / S-02 plans.
No footing at C1 or C2: grids 1 and 2 have no column at row C (the beams there run B to D). Row C carries only the F2 at C3.
Pile caps sit on hollow hexagonal piles Dia. 0.15 x 6.00 m (S-04): F1 4 piles, F2 6, F3 9, F4 12. F2 (1.20 x 0.75) and F4 (1.65 x 1.20) are drawn with the long side along x.
